flags.effect: Show the switch and change nothing
flags.name: --dry-run

flags.effect: Go back to the branch the last switch left, when nothing has moved since
flags.name: --undo

flags.effect: Fetch the tracked remote first, so the branch the other machine pushed is here
flags.name: --fetch

flags.effect: The machine whose branch to switch to (default: the one that published most recently on another branch)
flags.name: --machine

flags.effect: The hash of the reviewed plan; the switch stops when the plan has changed
flags.name: --plan-hash

flags.effect: The command to run in the checkout after the switch (stops after 2 minutes); it is remembered for this server while its text stays the same
flags.name: --build

flags.effect: Change the files only, even when a build command is remembered
flags.name: --no-build

flags.effect: Restart even when a call is running; the call ends
flags.name: --restart-now

flags.effect: Seconds to wait for the gateways' answers to the restart
flags.name: --wait

summary: Check out the branch another machine is on, when the work tree is clean: <server> [--machine <name>] [--fetch] [--dry-run] [--plan-hash] [--build|--no-build] [--restart-now|--no-restart], or --undo
